events.body:
The driver cancelled at 21:32:00 with the app reason rider_no_show [F4]. His messages and statement show he was waiting at Gate B, told the rider he could not stop at Gate A because of the double yellow line, and cancelled after the free wait had passed because the rider had not come to him [F10][F12][F13][F16]. The words read as a rider-no-show cancellation, not a reason of his own (no car trouble, no personal matter, no other job, no refusal of the trip), so NS-0 resolves to NS-1 and the fee path stands [NS-0]. No traffic or weather disrupts that reading [F17][F18][F19], and the profiles do not decide it [F20][F21].

Every NS-1 condition is met by the record. Arrival was confirmed by the driver's "I'm Here" tap at 21:26:00 at 150 m from the pickup, within the 200 m radius, with the closest approach 40 m [F1][F7]; the trace's NS-1(i) check passes [NS-1]. The free wait ran 6 min 0 s continuously from arrival before cancellation, past the 5-minute threshold [F3][F6][F7]; NS-1(ii) passes.

The contact conditions are also met: before cancelling, the driver sent 3 in-app messages (first 21:26:30) and made 1 in-app call (first 21:27:30) [F5][F15]; NS-1(iii) passes, so there is no NS-2 voiding basis. The rider never showed at Gate B; her only reply was to ask the driver to come to Gate A, which the driver declined for a stated legal reason and which is not a reason of the driver's own for cancelling [F11][F12]. The fee on record is $5.00 and the trace's NS-1 conditions all pass, so the fee stands [F8][F4][NS-1]. No repeat-rider situation arises: zero prior no-shows in 30 days, so no NS-9 flag and no flag_account [F20][NS-9].

The safety screen read every chat message, the call log, the driver's statement and the rider's complaint: the exchanges are a plain gate-dispute about where to meet — no threat, intimidation, harassment, abuse, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation appears [F10][F11][F12][F13][F15][F16]. Safety concern is none [SAFE-1]. The record is complete on every element this ruling needs (GPS presence, timestamps, the driver's own words on why he cancelled), so evidence is sufficient and no escalation is required [TH-4].

No further action is needed from you.
